newsitem.title: GERMANY: German trade seeks free mkt grain export rebates.
newsitem.headline: German trade seeks free mkt grain export rebates.

text.p: German grain traders bid for the export of 13,000 tonnes of free market soft wheat with rebates in a range between 15.05 and 18.83 Ecus per tonne, the state grain intervention board BLE said on Thursday.

Under a weekly EU grain export tender BLE also received bids to export 6,500 tonnes of free market barley where the restitutions sought were in a 31.25-31.49 Ecus a tonne range, and a bid to export 5,000 tonnes of free market rye, where the desired subsidy was 31.46 Ecus.
